identificationModule.officialTitle: TriCAR-T-CD19 Adoptive Immunotherapy for CD19-positive Refractory/Relapsed Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The tri-functional anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptor contains an anti-CD19 scFv, a PD-L1 blocker, and a cytokine complex, enabling the TriCAR-T-CD19 to simultaneously targeting the CD19 positive NHL，blocking the inhibitory PD-L1 signal and stimulating T/NK cell activation and expansion.
